info.title: Smart Reading Coach API
info.description: REST API of Smart Reading Coach. Errors are application/problem+json (RFC 9457). Send the language in the Accept-Language header (nl or en) to get translated error messages.

Role.description: What a user may do: students keep a profile, teachers follow students.

DesiredLength.description: How long the material may be.

ReadingStatus.description: Whether the student has read the title.

ReadingListSource.description: Where a title on the reading list came from: the advice page, the catalog or a teacher.

type.description: URI that identifies the kind of problem.

title.description: Short, fixed summary of the problem (the HTTP status text).

detail.description: Explanation for the user, in the language of the Accept-Language header.

instance.description: Path of the request that caused the problem.

name.description: Display name: first name, infix and last name together.

infix.description: Tussenvoegsel, for example "van der". Null when there is none.

token.description: JWT. Send it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

id.description: Catalog id (MongoDB ObjectId as 24 hex characters).

title.description: Title of the book or article.

format.description: Format of the material, for example paperback or e-book.

themes.description: Themes of the book. Used to match the topics in a reading profile.

levels.description: Language levels this title is suitable for. Empty when unknown.

levelLabel.description: Level as written in the source list.

url.description: Link to the title, when there is one.

Suggestion.description: A recommended book with the reason why it was recommended.

id.description: Catalog id (MongoDB ObjectId as 24 hex characters).

title.description: Title of the book or article.

format.description: Format of the material, for example paperback or e-book.

url.description: Link to the title, when there is one.

motivation.description: Why this title fits the reading profile, in one short sentence.

reasons.description: All reasons why this title fits, most important first.

AdviceSource.description: ai: the advice comes from the AI model. rules: the AI service was not available, the rule based scoring was used.

total.description: Number of books that match, all pages.

BookFacets.description: Values that can be used to filter the catalog.

ProfileInput.description: The answers a student gives in the reading profile.

materialTypes.description: Kinds of material the student likes to read.

topics.description: Topics of interest, at most 5. Must exist as a theme in the catalog.

materialTypes.description: Kinds of material the student likes to read.

topics.description: Topics of interest, at most 5. Must exist as a theme in the catalog.

ProfileOptions.description: The possible answers for the reading profile form.

topics.description: Topics a student can choose from (the catalog themes).

id.description: Id of the reading list entry.

source.description: Null for titles added before this was tracked.

rating.description: Stars the student gave after reading, null when not rated.

comment.description: What the student thought of it, in their own words.

book.description: The book, or null when it was removed from the catalog.

linked.description: Whether this teacher follows the student.

hasProfile.description: Whether a reading profile was saved.

earnedAt.description: When the badge was earned, null while it is not earned yet.

Progress.description: XP and badges of a student.

nextBadge.description: The next badge to earn, null when every badge is earned.

added.description: Of which added from the advice page.

AdviceStats.description: Whether the advice helps, over the students a teacher follows.

catalogAlsoSuggested.description: Added from the catalog, while Bo had shown the title as well.

ai.description: ok: the AI service answers and has a model. unavailable: it is configured but does not answer, the advice uses the rules. disabled: AI_SERVICE_URL is not set.

get.description: Based on the saved reading profile and the reading list. The AI model gives the advice when the AI service is available, otherwise the rule based scoring does. Each suggestion explains why it was recommended. Titles on the reading list are never suggested, so the advice changes when the student adds or reads titles.
